name: cTSString::ConstructEmpty (empty string-table loader: cleared text, key fields and reference count; vtable 0xda5128)
notes: 2,000 raw buffers pre-filled with random bytes: the 0x34 bytes (and the bytes after them) must match. Hooked; not run in game.

name: cTSString::Assign (copies the text and the key fields of another loader; self-assignment does nothing)
notes: 4,000 loader pairs (inline and heap texts, self-assignment 1 in 8): text, capacity, reference count, vtable and every key field must match. Hooked; not run in game. Every caller of ours (PrimSText, PrimAA70, ...) now calls this one.

name: cTSString::Construct(table, entry, group, loadFlags, resourceType) (loading constructor: key (type, group, table << 16 | entry, 0), flags byte; Load; ret 0x14)
notes: 4,000 seeded runs on raw buffers against the fake resource manager of tests/ts_string_fake.h (found or not, found-but-not-found output, manager present / through the service / absent, an error thrown from GetResource, Strlen or Data, 32-bit argument slots with garbage in the upper halves): the object, the bytes after it, every ask (key, interface id, flags, reserved), the order of the calls, the releases and the cache global must match; a load that throws destroys the string again (raw bytes compared). Hooked; not run in game.

name: cTSString::Construct(table, entry, group, resourceType) (the same without a flags byte: flags and loaded byte 0; ret 0x10)
notes: As 0x1d0df0 (4,000 runs). Same first 32 bytes as 0x1d0df0 up to the flag store; hooked with its own CRC entry; not run in game.

name: cTSString::Load (TSStringLoad: asks the resource manager for the key as a cIGZString, copies the text with bullets (U+2022) replaced by zero width spaces, releases the resource; clears the text when not found)
notes: 6,000 seeded runs with a loader holding a random previous text and key fields, against the fake resource manager: result, text, capacity, every field, the asks, the call order (GetResource, Strlen before Data, Release), the number of releases (also when not found but a resource was handed out, and when Strlen or Data throws) and the cache global. The replaced text has no bullet left. The release after the copy is noexcept as in the original (an error from Release ends the process: not testable). Hooked; not run in game. Callees: the cached resource manager getter 0x9c5b26 (ours), cRZString Find / Replace (ours).

name: cTSString::DeletingDestructor (slot 33: the string is destroyed, the vtable is cRZString's again; flags & 1 frees the 0x34 bytes; ret 4)
notes: 400 heap objects of exactly 0x34 bytes with flags 0..3: return value, freed or not (HeapValidate), and the destroyed object compared. Hooked as cTSString_vf33; not run in game.

name: cTSString slot 16 (cIGZString operator=; a jmp to cRZString::operator= 0x1ac9d0)
notes: 2,000 runs (self-assignment 1 in 8, texts with bullets, empty): result, text, capacity and the key fields compared with the original thunk. Not hooked: hookspec refuses thunks, and the slot reaches the hooked cRZString::operator= anyway.

name: CachedServiceGetter<0x10f51a8, 0x056b906e, 0x656b8efc> (the cached resource manager, global 0xa10f51a8; cIGZPersistResourceManager)
notes: The shape of the eight getters of rz/ServiceGetters.h (verified there), so it is that template: the test compares the original and the instantiation for cache set, cache empty with a service object, and no service object (result, cache global, calls, the identifiers the service is asked with). Hooked; the manager it returns answers GetResource at slot 3 (method fact in db/methods/cTSString.jsonl).
